span.p:
1 · BeforeModelStateInjection — CUSTOM
hook: before_model
prepends captured fields, phase requirements,
missing fields, key_decisions, open_items
at the TOP of the prompt, ahead of the conversation

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2 · DMAICSkillsMiddleware — CUSTOM
progressive disclosure, three levels
L1 descriptions under 2K tokens for all five phases
L2 full phase SKILL.md via the load_skill tool
allowed-tools must match this phase's tool subset

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3 · SummarizationMiddleware — LANGCHAIN CORE, as shipped
trigger 100k tokens · keep last 20 messages raw
model: operational-model, gpt-4o-mini for cost
compresses CONVERSATION — facts live in typed state

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
model + tool-calling loop
get_llm coach · temperature 0.5-0.7
response_format=ProviderStrategy PhaseOutput
recursion_limit=11 — max 5 tool calls per Belt turn

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4 · DMAICGraderMiddleware — CUSTOM
hook: after_agent · grader role · temperature 0.1
per-criterion verdicts, not one overall verdict
max_iterations=3, on_evaluation writes to step_log
THE BELT NEVER SEES THIS LOOP
